title: The failure fingerprint misses the test id behind GitLab's stream marker, so different failures join one bug
goal: backlog.first_failure strips GitLab.com's per-line timestamp and stream marker (00O, 01O, 01E) before matching, so the failing test id is found in real job logs; three kb-tests-windows logs that fail on different tests give three fingerprints; a planted log with the stream marker is in test_backlog.py

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import backlog; r=backlog.first_failure('2026-09-29T01:06:40.889927Z 01O FAILED _tools/test_a.py::test_x - AssertionError\n'); assert r == '_tools/test_a.py::test_x', r
